x-op-descriptions.list: List a host's local models: size, context, loaded and resident state, mode.
x-op-descriptions.load: Load one local model by id.
x-op-descriptions.unload: Unload one model by id, or every model with id all.
x-op-descriptions.swap: Unload every model that is not resident, then load id.
x-op-descriptions.pull: Download a model from a Hugging Face repo, link or bare name, then list it.
x-op-descriptions.mode: Show a host's GPU mode, or switch it: odin or kreate on mini, odin or gaming on pc.

id.description: Model id from list; unload accepts all.

source.description: pull: a Hugging Face owner/repo or owner/repo:file, a link, or a model name.

file.description: pull: the GGUF file name inside the repo.

mode.description: mode: odin, kreate or gaming. Omitted shows the current mode.

host.description: Fleet host name, such as mini or pc. Omitted runs on the host Odin runs on.
